cards.title: Registration and Tryouts
cards.body:
Fall 2026 Core season registration is still open.

Please go to the "Registration" tab to complete the necessary steps.

Fall 2026 Core season dates are 9/19 through 11/22.

No playground or Core games on 10/10 - 10/11, in observance of Columbus/Indigenous Peoples' Day weekend.

Fall 2026 Silent Soccer weekends: September 26/27, October 24/25, and November 14/15.

---

**Travel Team Tryouts 2026-2027**

Still looking for a Travel Team?
Complete our inquiry form to hear about current opportunities!

[West Side Travel Team Inquiry Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSguwCt_bvmRm3EIMJqlwBwRzcszwsCy8Qh-0kA25Qw6Y1QA/viewform)
